persons.name: Devendra
persons.evidence: likhitaṃ śrīdevendraśarmmaṇā ... devendreṇa sudhiyā śrīcaṇḍikāyā catuḥpañcāśadvarapāṭhapustakam ado dattaṃ dvijebhyo mudā

notes: The manuscript was copied on Āṣāḍha śukla 5, Sunday, NS 811 by Devendra Śarman. A following verse records the donation of the fifty-four-recitation manuscript (catuḥpañcāśadvarapāṭhapustakam) to Brahmins in the month of Śrāvaṇa on a Friday (kavidine) under Śravaṇā nakṣatra.
